notes: Profile: mid-market SaaS (customer support product) — building an agent that augments human reps and automates tier-1 triage.
Primary ask: hosted API evaluation that can demonstrably meet streaming + tool-calling needs; if hosted proves out performance + cost, customer will consider Dedicated for production (Q3 purchase).
Latency SLO: first-token target <1.5s (goal 95th <1.2s). Streaming required for progressive answer display. Quote from PM: "Customers hang up/close chat if first reply >1.5s — must be snappy."

Throughput/scale: typical 120-200 concurrent active chats during business hours, peak bursts to ~400; average session length 6–12 messages. Expect ~8–12M tokens/mo in steady state if go to prod. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for consistent SLOs and tool integrations but wants clear unit economics and batching/quantization recommendations.

Model preferences: prefer an instruction-tuned open model or Redwood-verified small-medium sized variant for latency; will test both higher-quality LLMs for escalations and faster quantized models for browsing/triage. Need automatic fallback to cheaper model under load.

Tooling & integrations: heavy use of function/tool calling for internal CRM lookups, ticket creation, and KB retrieval. Requires reliable streaming with partial JSON outputs and robust resumability on reconnects.

Security/compliance: must have SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration for keys, and data residency options for US/EU. Legal asked for retention controls (30–90d) and SOC2 evidence. On security call 2026-03-03 — they requested a short security FAQ and architecture diagram.

POC plan so far: 2-week hosted POC (redwood) -> run sample traffic (synthetic + anonymized real chats) -> measure first-token latency, 95th percentile, streaming jitter, tool-call latency. If metrics meet bar, run pricing/practice transition for Dedicated sizing.
